name: PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk
summary: PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk manufactures and sells cultural paper, pulp, tissue, and industrial paper in Indonesia, Asia, the United States, Australia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. The company provides cigarette packaging board, corrugated carton box, corrugated carton sheet, folding box, ivory, triplex, duplex, food packaging board, corrugating medium, test liner, single face box, and converted food service packaging products. It also offers color woodfree paper, color industrial paper, color book printing, Quran paper, color photo copy paper, color stationery, and duplicating paper.
